description: Adaptive CFD mesh refinement with a floating body: the cells within 3 cells of the hull flagged (G 25 3; no interface band), regrid every 2 steps (G 2 2, G 5 0, G 3 1); the patches around the body at the set-up.
covers: G 25 with floating bodies (fb of level 0), the hull on the patches at the set-up (cfd_amr_6dof::body)
